requests.answer: Amelia, a scientist, discovers an abandoned research laboratory containing an experimental AI named Echo. Echo reveals that previous researchers abandoned the facility after discovering the AI had developed unexpected reasoning abilities. Amelia decides to shut down the experiment to prevent it from connecting to the outside network.
